# load packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggraph)
library(tidygraph)
library(igraph)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Load the data

```{r}
file <- "../../results/main_table_cpgs_eqtms_gex.csv"
df.main.table <- read_csv(file)

df.top30.eqtms <- df.main.table %>%
            arrange(adj.P.Val.cpg) %>%
            slice(1:30)



df.eqtms <- df.main.table %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene.symbol)) %>%  # Remove rows where gene.symbol is NA
  arrange(adj.P.Val.cpg) 

df <- df.eqtms %>%
        filter(sig.GEX.genes == "TRUE")
  
```


```{r}
unique(df$gene.symbol)
```

```{r}
result.dir.plots <- "../../results/05_EQTm/assoc_CpG_GEX/plots_viz/"
dir.create(result.dir.plots, recursive = TRUE)

```

```{r}

df.top30.eqtms <- df
# Create edges data frame - ensure all CpGs have edges to their genes
edges <- df.top30.eqtms %>%
  select(from = CpG.id, to = gene.symbol, weight = logFC.eqtm) %>%
  filter(!is.na(to) & to != "" & !is.na(from))  # Remove any missing values

# Create nodes data frame
all_cpgs <- unique(df.top30.eqtms$CpG.id)
all_genes <- unique(na.omit(df.top30.eqtms$gene.symbol[df.top30.eqtms$gene.symbol != ""]))

nodes <- data.frame(
  id = c(all_cpgs, all_genes),
  type = c(rep("CpG", length(all_cpgs)), rep("Gene", length(all_genes)))
)

# Create a graph object
graph <- tbl_graph(nodes = nodes, edges = edges, directed = TRUE) %>%
  activate(edges) %>%
  mutate(abs_weight = abs(weight))

# Plot the graph
plot <- ggraph(graph, layout = "fr", weights = abs_weight) +
  geom_edge_link(
    aes(width = abs(weight), 
        color = ifelse(weight > 0, "Positive", "Negative")),
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_node_point(aes(color = type), size = 3) +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = id), repel = TRUE, size = 3, max.overlaps = 20) +
  scale_edge_width(range = c(0.5, 2), name = "|logFC|") +
  scale_edge_color_manual(
    values = c("Positive" = "blue", "Negative" = "red"),
    name = "logFC Direction"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("CpG" = "darkgreen", "Gene" = "purple"),
    name = "Node Type"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, "in"),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "CpGs and Regulated Genes",
    #subtitle = "Blue edges: logFC > 0, Red edges: logFC < 0"
  )

print(plot)

# Save the plot to a file with high quality (300 dpi)
ggsave(
  filename =  file.path(result.dir.plots, "top30_eqtm_genes_cpgs_graph_plot.png"),
  plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300,
  units = "in",
  bg = "white", 
  #device = "png"
  device = "png"
  )
```

```{r}
# Create nodes and edges data frames
edges <- data.frame(
  from = df.meth.status$CpG.id,  # CpG IDs
  to = df.meth.status$gene.symbol, # Gene IDs
  weight = df.meth.status$logFC         # Edge weights (e.g., correlation or significance)
)

id = c(unique(df.meth.status$CpG.id), df.meth.status$gene.symbol)
type = ifelse(grepl("cg", id), "CpG", "Gene")

nodes <- data.frame(
  id = id,
  type = type
)
nodes
```


```{r}
# Create a graph object
graph <- tbl_graph(nodes = nodes, edges = edges, directed = TRUE) %>%
  activate(edges) %>%
  mutate(abs_weight = abs(weight)) 

# Plot the graph
plot <- ggraph(graph, layout = "fr", weights = abs_weight) +  # Use absolute weights for layout
  geom_edge_link(aes(width = abs(weight), color = weight > 0), alpha = 0.6) +  # Color by weight sign
  geom_node_point(aes(color = type), size = 2) +  # Nodes colored by type
  geom_node_text(aes(label = id), repel = TRUE, size = 3) +  # Node labels
  scale_edge_width(range = c(0.5, 2)) +  # Adjust edge width range
  scale_edge_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "blue", "FALSE" = "red")) +  # Set edge colors
  theme_void() +  # Clean theme
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, "in"),  # Margin adjustments
    legend.position = "none"  # Remove edge color legend
  ) +
  labs(title = "hypo-methylated CpGs and Regulated Genes")

print(plot)

# Save the plot to a file with high quality (300 dpi)
ggsave(
  filename =  file.path(hypo.result.dir, "hypo_methylation_plot_fc02.png"),
  plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300,
  units = "in",
  bg = "white", 
  device = "png")

```
